newsitem.title: FINLAND: Family fight lands Finnish mediator in court.
newsitem.headline: Family fight lands Finnish mediator in court.

text.p: Finland's government-appointed industrial abitrator went to court on Thursday to face charges of violence after police had to intervene to halt a family fight at his home, court officials said.

Jorma Reini, whose mediation skills prevented many strikes, was charged with beating his daughter, violently resisting police and damaging a police car in a December scuffle which also involved his wife and another woman, they said.
Reini, 54, has a reputation as a tough negotiator who can wear down the most hard-nosed union and industry leader.

He made headlines in 1990 after sending a controversial postcard to Finland's equality ombudsman with the slogan "Vive l'homme" (Long Live Men) above a cartoon showing a naked woman parachuting over a sea of erect penises.
